newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures close quiet trade firmer.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures close quiet trade firmer.

text.p: Nov 4 - U.S. debt futures ended quiet afternoon trading firmer. Traders said activity remained very light before start of Treasury's refunding and U.S. presidential election on Tuesday. Opinions varied about nearterm outlook for Dec T-bonds, which some said could use more downward correction but others said still look in strong technical position. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
